title: E: two-object task in 6 steps (C needed 13)
initial_observation:
-= Welcome to TextWorld, ALFRED! =-

You are in the middle of a room. Looking quickly around you, you see a bed 2, a bed 1, a desk 1, a drawer 3, a drawer 2, a drawer 1, a garbagecan 1, a laundryhamper 1, and a shelf 1.

Your task is to: put two cd in drawer.
plan: go to desk 1 where cd 2 is located
go to desk 1 to find cd 1

rules_shown.rule: When placing multiple objects in a target, search all furniture surfaces first, then navigate to the target before each move command.
rules_shown.example: Search countertop 1 for peppershaker 2, go to diningtable 1, move peppershaker 2 to diningtable 1, search countertop 1 for peppershaker 3, go to diningtable 1, move peppershaker 3 to diningtable 1.
rules_shown.validation: Confirmed by this game: agent searched countertop 1, then navigated to diningtable 1 before each move command. | Confirmed by this game: agent found second laptop on ottoman 1 after placing first one, completing task efficiently.
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Success Process] When placing multiple objects in a target, search all furniture surfaces first, then navigate to the target before each move command. Example: Search countertop 1 for peppershaker 2, go to diningtable 1, move peppershaker 2 to diningtable 1, search countertop 1 for peppershaker 3, go to diningtable 1, move peppershaker 3 to diningtable 1.

rules_shown.rule: When searching for the object, search furniture surfaces first before opening any drawers or cabinets.
rules_shown.example: Agent searched countertop 1 before opening cabinet 2 and cabinet 3.
rules_shown.validation: Agent wasted time opening empty drawers/cabinets before finding the second cellphone on armchair 2.
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Special Phenomenon] When searching for the object, search furniture surfaces first before opening any drawers or cabinets. Example: Agent searched countertop 1 before opening cabinet 2 and cabinet 3.

rules_shown.rule: When two objects must be placed in a target: search furniture surfaces first, take each object, move it to the target.
rules_shown.example: In the failed attempt, moving while holding the object failed; in the successful retry, the agent went to shelf 1 before moving.
rules_shown.validation: Confirmed by this game: agent moved pencil 2 to drawer 2 after navigating to drawer 2, but failed when trying to move pencil 3 without navigating first (though it succeeded later after navigating).
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Corrected Error] When two objects must be placed in a target: search furniture surfaces first, take each object, move it to the target. Example: In the failed attempt, moving while holding the object failed; in the successful retry, the agent went to shelf 1 before moving.

rules_shown_to: planner (as the "rules" field of its prompt, before it writes subgoals) and actor (as the block "Rules learned from earlier practice (follow them)" in every step prompt); one set chosen once from the goal
shows: Rules: a recipe plus a special-phenomenon note ("search furniture surfaces first before opening drawers"). The agent finds both CDs on the desk, with one invalid `go to drawer 1` (the drawer was already reachable).
why_interesting: The recipe tells the planner to take each object and move it before the second; the plan lists the second CD as its own subgoal.
